summary.title: Penetration Testing: A Hands-On Introduction to Hacking
summary.one_liner: A beginner-oriented book by Georgia Weidman that introduces penetration testing through hands-on hacking practice.
takeaways: Penetration Testing: A Hands-On Introduction to Hacking is a beginner-focused book by Georgia Weidman, published by No Starch Press.
Reviewers describe it as a good starting point for learning about security domains, finding vulnerabilities, and exploitation.
Reviewers note the book uses simple language and well-illustrated explanations for novices.
The page notes a newer edition is in progress and that related courses are taught around this book.
summary.summary: This No Starch Press product page promotes Georgia Weidman's book on penetration testing, subtitled A Hands-On Introduction to Hacking. The page is almost entirely reader and reviewer quotes praising it as a beginner resource covering security domains, vulnerability discovery, and exploitation methods. It contains no table of contents, chapter list, price, or platform details, so the specific technical content is not described beyond these endorsements.
